title.en: Where a Chip Became an Architect

en: Gates existed in a box before a spark.

highlight.en: The temperature of a room, the hum of fans.

moral.en: Control is silent, power is loud.

cta.en: Notice the quiet before the storm.

narration.en: I watched a tiny chip glow behind glass.
